	3–5 years of relevant experience in civil engineering, construction, maintenance, petrochemical, fertilizer, or industrial plant environments.
	Experience in industrial maintenance and construction is required.
	Experience in residential/property maintenance is an added advantage.
	Strong understanding of civil and structural engineering practices, site execution, and contractor coordination.
	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.
	Good knowledge of quality and safety requirements in industrial/project environments.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
	Good written and verbal communication skills in English.


Performance Indicators


	Adherence to project schedules and approved plans
	Compliance with quality and safety standards
	Budget adherence
	Timely completion of civil/structural works
	Waste reduction and efficient resource utilization
	Zero accidents and strong HSE performance.


Key Competencies:


	Civil & Structural Engineering | Industrial Construction | Project Coordination | Site Inspection | Contractor Management | Engineering Documentation | Quality Control | Safety Compliance | Technical Problem-Solving | Progress Monitoring.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using ''Civil Engineer'' as the subject of the email.

Note: Only qualified candidates would be contacted.

        TeamAce Limited - Our client, a reputable organization in the media and PR Industry, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Operation & Media Support Associate
Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	As the Operations & Media Support Associate, you will provide administrative and operational support to the PR operations team, ensuring effective coordination of client deliverables, media activities, internal workflows, and project timelines.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Support daily PR operations by tracking client deliverables, media activities, internal workflows, and project timelines
	Maintain operational documents, reports, project records, and other relevant documentation to ensure accurate and timely information management
	Coordinate communication and activities between internal teams, clients, media contacts, and external partners to support seamless project execution
	Manage scheduling, meetings, follow-ups, and task coordination while ensuring key deadlines and commitments are effectively tracked
	Monitor operational workflows, identify potential bottlenecks, and recommend practical improvements to enhance team efficiency and service delivery


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Mass Communication, Public Relations, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
	1–3 years of relevant experience in Operations, Media Support, Public Relations, Communications, or a related role
	Strong organizational, multitasking, written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace; familiarity with PR and media workflows is an added advantage
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a fast-paced hybrid work environment while effectively managing multiple priorities.
